moments.title: Strictly's Grand Return
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing launches with a brand new format, new hosts and a fresh celebrity lineup on Saturday, September 19th on BBC One.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-charge! Strictly Come Dancing is back with its launch show on September 19th. Who are you rooting for this year?

angles.name: New Hosts & Format
angles.copy: New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are shaking up Strictly this year, with a fresh pairing format on the launch show. Ready for the changes?

moments.title: Bake Off Returns with New Judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Monday, September 22nd at 8pm on Channel 4, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: Our favourite tent is back! The Great British Bake Off starts September 22nd on Channel 4. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge on The Great British Bake Off! We can't wait to see her take on the bakes when it starts September 22nd.

moments.title: Pink turns 47
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Pink, born Alecia Moore, celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 47th birthday to the incredible Pink tomorrow! What's your ultimate power anthem from her?

angles.name: Iconic Performer
angles.copy: Celebrating the one and only Pink's 47th birthday tomorrow! From 'Get The Party Started' to 'Cover Me In Sunshine', she's a true legend.

moments.title: Aimee Mann turns 66
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American singer-songwriter Aimee Mann, known for her solo work and 'Til Tuesday, celebrates her 66th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Indie Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Aimee Mann tomorrow! From 'Voices Carry' to her acclaimed solo albums, she's a songwriting master.

moments.title: Michael Bublé turns 51
moments.blurb: Canadian crooner Michael Bublé, known for his smooth jazz and pop hits, celebrates his 51st birthday on September 9th.

angles.name: Smooth Operator's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to the incomparable Michael Bublé, who turns 51 on September 9th! What's your favourite track from the king of swing?

angles.name: Bublé's Best
angles.copy: Happy 51st birthday to Michael Bublé on Wednesday! His voice makes every song a love song. Which one is your favourite?

moments.title: Dave Stewart turns 74
moments.blurb: British musician, songwriter, and producer Dave Stewart, best known as one half of Eurythmics, celebrates his 74th birthday on September 9th.

angles.name: Eurythmics Legend
angles.copy: Sweet dreams are made of this! Happy 74th birthday to Dave Stewart of Eurythmics on Wednesday!

moments.title: Joe Perry turns 76
moments.blurb: American guitarist and founding member of Aerosmith, Joe Perry, celebrates his 76th birthday on September 10th.

angles.name: Aerosmith Icon
angles.copy: Walk This Way to wish Joe Perry of Aerosmith a very happy 76th birthday on Thursday!

moments.title: Siobhan Fahey turns 68
moments.blurb: Irish-born singer Siobhan Fahey, known for Bananarama and Shakespears Sister, celebrates her 68th birthday on September 10th.

angles.name: 80s Pop Star
angles.copy: Cruel Summer or 'Stay'? Happy 68th birthday to the fabulous Siobhan Fahey on Thursday!

moments.title: Moby turns 61
moments.blurb: American electronic music pioneer Moby, born Richard Melville Hall, celebrates his 61st birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Electronic Music Legend
angles.copy: Feeling 'Porcelain'? Happy 61st birthday to the incredible Moby on Friday! What's your top Moby track?

angles.name: 90s Dancefloor Filler
angles.copy: From 'Go' to 'Natural Blues', Moby defined a sound. Wishing him a very happy 61st birthday on Friday!

moments.title: Richard Ashcroft turns 55
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter Richard Ashcroft, lead vocalist of The Verve, celebrates his 55th birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Britpop Icon
angles.copy: The 'Drugs Don't Work' but his music always does. Happy 55th birthday to The Verve's Richard Ashcroft on Friday!

moments.title: Jonny Buckland turns 49
moments.blurb: British musician Jonny Buckland, lead guitarist of Coldplay, celebrates his 49th birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Coldplay Guitarist
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 49th birthday to Coldplay's brilliant guitarist, Jonny Buckland, on Friday! What's your favourite Coldplay riff?

moments.title: Jennifer Hudson turns 45
moments.blurb: Oscar and Grammy-winning American singer and actress Jennifer Hudson celebrates her 45th birthday on September 12th.

angles.name: Dreamgirl's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 45th birthday to the sensational Jennifer Hudson on Saturday! From 'And I Am Telling You' to her talk show, she truly is a star.

angles.name: Voice of an Angel
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible talent of Jennifer Hudson, who turns 45 this Saturday! Her voice is pure magic.

moments.title: Niall Horan turns 33
moments.blurb: Irish singer-songwriter Niall Horan, formerly of One Direction, celebrates his 33rd birthday on September 13th.

angles.name: One Direction Star
angles.copy: Happy 33rd birthday to our favourite Irishman, Niall Horan, on Sunday! What's your go-to Niall solo track?

angles.name: Niall's Big Day
angles.copy: Counting down to Niall Horan's 33rd birthday on Sunday! What's a song that always reminds you of him?

moments.title: Peter Cetera turns 82
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter and bassist Peter Cetera, best known as the lead vocalist of Chicago, celebrates his 82nd birthday on September 13th.

angles.name: Voice of Chicago
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to Peter Cetera, the iconic voice of Chicago, on Sunday! 'Hard to Say I'm Sorry' is still a classic.

moments.title: Morten Harket turns 67
moments.blurb: Norwegian singer Morten Harket, lead vocalist of the synth-pop band a-ha, celebrates his 67th birthday on September 14th.

angles.name: Take On Me Legend
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the unmistakable voice of a-ha, Morten Harket, on Monday! 'Take On Me' still sounds as fresh as ever.

moments.title: Nas turns 53
moments.blurb: American rapper and record executive Nas, born Nasir Jones, celebrates his 53rd birthday on September 14th.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 53rd birthday to the legendary rapper Nas on Monday! What's your favourite album from the Illmatic icon?

moments.title: Jaki Graham turns 69
moments.blurb: British R&B and dance singer Jaki Graham, known for 80s hits like 'Set Me Free', celebrates her 69th birthday on September 15th.

angles.name: 80s Soul Queen
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the incredible Jaki Graham on Tuesday! 'Set Me Free' is still an absolute bop.

moments.title: Paul Thomson turns 50
moments.blurb: Scottish musician Paul Thomson, former drummer for the indie rock band Franz Ferdinand, celebrates his 50th birthday on September 15th.

angles.name: Franz Ferdinand Drummer
angles.copy: Take Me Out to wish Paul Thomson, formerly of Franz Ferdinand, a very happy 50th birthday on Tuesday!
